platforms.text:
Claude just added new artifact types, including an infinite-canvas Whiteboard. On my Pro account it was not there.

What I checked, in about three minutes:
• Settings → Capabilities: there is no beta switch for it
• Asked Claude: my plan qualifies, the rollout had not reached my account yet
• Quit and reopen the app, update the Mac, remove the old copy
• Meanwhile: Docs, Slides, Design and Data work fine

Honest result: the Whiteboard had not reached me yet. The checklist is worth keeping for the next feature that goes missing.

Want it in depth? Join the Delivery Pilot community on Skool: https://www.skool.com/delivery-pilot-8938

#Claude #ClaudeAI #AITools #Artifacts
